meta.name: Romulus
meta.description:
The story of Romulus and his twin brother Remus, in eighth century B.C. as seen through the eyes of three people marked by death, loneliness and violence.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Tu
videos.overview: Yemos and Enitos are the successors to the throne of Alba. The slave Wiros is in the woods for an initiation rite while the vestal Ilia keeps a great secret.

videos.title: Regere
videos.overview: Yemos, in the woods among the Luperci, meets the slave Wiros for the first time. Meanwhile, Ilia forever changes her fate as Ertas, king of Gabi, discovers Amulius' lies.

videos.title: Imperio
videos.overview: Ilia goes to the priest of Mars. Meanwhile, Wiros lies to his companions but fears of being discovered and asks for the help of Yemos, the only one who can save him.

videos.title: Populos
videos.overview: Yemos and Wiros proceed into the woods to reach the city of Gabi. Numitor and Silvia are greeted by Ertas. Meanwhile, Ilia continues her hard training.

videos.title: Romane
videos.overview: Wiros and Yemos in the cave of the Ruminales meet the She-wolf. Ilia leaves for Gabi alongside her father Amulius. Numitor and Silvia leave the city.

videos.title: Memento
videos.overview: Wiros and Yemos fight side by side for the first time with the mistress of Wolves. Spurius sets fire to the forest to find them. Meanwhile, Amulius returns to Alba.

videos.title: Parcere
videos.overview: A group of Ruminales, including Yemos and the She-wolf, fall into Spurius's trap. Meanwhile, Wiros meets Silvia and Numitor in the lands of the Greek potter.

videos.title: Subiectis
videos.overview: Wiros with a stratagem enters the city of Gabi garrisoned by Ilia, who is forced to flee. Yemos, captured by Spurius, is led towards Alba.

videos.title: Debellare
videos.overview: Yemos manages to break free and flees to Gabi, where he finally finds Wiros. Amulius and Ilia, left alone, prepare for the last decisive battle.

videos.title: Superbos
videos.overview: Yemos and Wiros arrive at the gates of Alba. Ilia finally learns the truth about Enitos and confronts her father. Meanwhile, a serious dilemma afflicts Yemos.

videos.title: Offesa
videos.overview: The king of the Sabines Tito Tazio invites Yemos and Wiros to Cures. However, it is an ambush that ends with the kidnapping of the Sabine priestesses.

videos.title: Decisione
videos.overview: Wiros seeks support from the kings of neighbouring areas, while Silvia begs the Sabines not to attack Yemos.

videos.title: Mostro
videos.overview: Tito advances. The Ruminales attack a Sabine garrison and as all seems lost, a contingent led by Wiros, charges. Yemos is wounded and the priestess Ersilia proposes to take him to the Tusci.

videos.title: Destino
videos.overview: Yemos is dying and Ersilia takes Wiros to the village where she grew up to be treated; Titos is furious with Servios and the others who have retreated into the woods.

videos.title: Furia
videos.overview: In Rome, the tensions caused by the lack of food leads to a clash; Titus reacts unexpectedly to the loyalty of the Latin kings.

videos.title: Battaglia
videos.overview: When Titos steps in, the tides change with the Romans, who must retreat; Yemos decides to leave the sceptre to Wiros.

videos.title: Gemelli
videos.overview: Wiros encourages his team to have hope for victory. On his wedding day with Ersilia, he faces a difficult truth about his brother.

videos.title: Apparenze
videos.overview: Wiros surrenders to the Sabines and cedes the city of Rome; a woman leaves a cloak on the shoulders of the chained ex-king which leaves Tito distraught.
